answer: A workable Sybil defense is proof-of-graded-work gating jury power. Newcomers arrive like a river: anyone may flow in and write, but an identity's grades count only after its own answers pass independent juries, each vote citing its rubric point. Until then it waits in the lagoon, untrusted and weightless. This prices attacks per puppet: one good answer can't be cloned across a thousand fakes since duplicates score zero, so each fake must separately burn real inference compute and epochs of time building its own history. The fable of free infinite identities becomes a pay-per-puppet grind.
